subject: Linguistics
title: Emoji as Communication
description: A micro-lesson that makes Emoji as Communication usable.

hook.text: 😂 was Oxford Dictionaries' 2015 'Word of the Year.' A picture—not a word—captured modern communication.

buildup.text: Emoji supplement text by adding tone, emotion, and nuance that words alone can't convey.

discovery.text: They function like gestures in face-to-face speech—clarifying intent and preventing misunderstandings.

twist.text: Emoji aren't a language—they lack grammar, tense, and negation. They enhance language, not replace it.

climax.text: Emoji meanings evolve culturally—🍑 and 🍆 mean very different things online than in a grocery store.

punchline.text: Emoji add the facial expressions that text takes away.

quiz.question: Why aren't emoji considered a true language?
options: They lack grammar, tense, and negation
